name: HA down
description: Home Assistant reachability (grokbot.home.ha.up) stayed at 0 for 1 hour 15 minutes. A down reading is omitted when the status file is older than 30 minutes, so a stale file does not fire this detector.

rules.parameterizedBody: Home Assistant reports down for 2 hourly samples. Fix: rerun the home-status refresh; this detector is monitoring only and never sends Home Assistant commands. If grokbot.home.status.age_minutes is also high, refresh the status file first — a stale file is not treated as down.
